children: AI startup Arlequin said on Thursday it had raised €28 million ($33 million) in a funding round led by Redalpine and OTB Ventures, as the French company expands its software aimed at financial crime investigations, security and defence customers.
Arlequin said it had signed BNP Paribas
and government agencies in four European countries as customers, but declined to identify the agencies. The new funding will be used to expand the software, it added.
State-owned Bpifrance's Defence Innovation Fund, Vsquared Ventures, 10x Founders and Xavier Niel also participated in the round.
Arlequin was founded in 2024 by a researcher specialised in terrorism and a former engineer at France's public CNRS research agency.
Its AI processes materials used in investigations, including documents, transaction records, video and data from devices.
The company declined to disclose its revenue, valuation or the size of contracts with its customers.
